_comment: Copy this file to live-run.local.json and fill it in. That filename is gitignored.
Never commit a real key, and never paste one into a chat, an issue, or a PR.
Each entry under `runs` is one named profile. Select one with --profile <name>.
auth.kind is one of: openrouter, openai-api, anthropic-api, codex-subscription.
codexExecutable and codexHome are required only by codex.basic harnesses.
The runner provisions prime.agent and codex.basic. Codex runs only with a codex-subscription login.
